description: The plot illustrates the Mean Interclass Similarity across various data points, comparing three different configurations: "w/o DPO obo", "w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint", and "DPO". The x-axis represents the data points, ranging from 0 to 60 with a linear scale and a tick label interval of 10. The y-axis represents the Mean Interclass Similarity, ranging from 0.0 to 0.5 with a linear scale and a tick label interval of 0.1. The "w/o DPO obo" configuration is represented by a blue solid line, which starts at approximately 0.107 and fluctuates across the x-axis, peaking at around 0.5 at x=2 and ending at approximately 0.05 at x=60. The "w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint" configuration is represented by an orange solid line, which starts at approximately 0.158 and also fluctuates, peaking at around 0.4 at multiple points, including x=27 and x=31. The "DPO" configuration is represented by a green solid line, which starts at approximately 0.086 and remains relatively stable, with some fluctuations, ending at approximately 0.1 at x=60. Additionally, the average Mean Interclass Similarity for each configuration is represented by dashed lines of the same color as their respective solid lines, with values of approximately 0.107, 0.158, and 0.086 for "w/o DPO obo", "w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint", and "DPO", respectively.
